author: Daniele Morais
title: Volcanic activity: alerta orange for Philippines
seoTitle: Volcanic activity in Philippines: alert orange
subtitle: The global disaster alert system rates event "Taal" at orange (moderate to high) level.
excerpt: Volcanic activity puts Philippines under orange (moderate to high) alert in the international GDACS system.
contentHtml:
GDACS, the global disaster alert and coordination system run by the UN and the European Commission, issued a orange (moderate to high) alert for event "Taal" (volcanic activity) affecting Philippines.

From the official bulletin: Volcano Taal is emitting ash clouds according to the regional VAAC. The aviation alert level is Orange.

What the alert level means

GDACS rates events green, orange or red based on estimated humanitarian impact — exposed population, regional vulnerability and local response capacity.

With data from GDACS (Global Disaster Alert and Coordination System).
